proof_locations: Condition at entry, choose the event density or survival contribution, and factor out the independent censoring law. The formal theorem starts from these joint event/censor factors.
Differentiate the log-time location-scale transformation and compose it with the baseline survival derivative. This is the original-time density Jacobian used by STATADIC.
Evaluate the Weibull survivor under its specified normalized baseline law, then differentiate with respect to original time.
Evaluate the lognormal survivor under its specified normalized baseline law, then differentiate with respect to original time.
Slice the independent product law in each time direction and normalize the resulting event measures by the entry probability.
